item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello, and welcome! Here is your weather report for Wednesday, September 16. Wednesday. We are halfway through the week! Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be cloudy with hardly any sun. The warmest part of the day will be 30 degrees, and the coolest 20. It will feel hot and sticky out there. There is almost no chance of rain today. There are 9 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? It's a hot one. A sun hat and a water bottle are a good idea! As for tomorrow, expect it to be damp with light drizzle, with a high of 30 degrees. Still thinking about school bags and desks this week. Has anything surprised you? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
